sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 40 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 30% elevation for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 60 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 30000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 30000
All Element Defense from Unison Damage +300
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Recovers 100 Cost.
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the Ability Power of the 300-Ability-Power attack that deals physical light damage to all enemies 5 times at success of 100 by 200.
Only [War Cloud] Kyouka & Himari can be used as Unlocking Potential material
